meta.how: subagent reads SKILL.md, uses scripts/search.py and data/

answers.media-three-images: 4 points (out of 6). Image tiers are 1->1, 2->2, 3->4, 4+->6, the featured image counts as an image, and no videos adds nothing.
answers.power-words-zh-skipped: No, it is skipped. The test loads assets/vendor/powerwords/<site language>.php, and the plugin ships only de, en, es, fi, fr, hu, id, it, ja, nl and sv lists. There is no zh list, so a Chinese site has nothing to check against.
answers.howto-save-classes: (a) rank-math-howto-step, (b) rank-math-howto-title (an h3 by default, set by titleWrapper), (c) rank-math-howto-content. All of these sit inside the wp-block-rank-math-howto-block wrapper.
answers.verifier-word-gate: It passes at 600 visible words (wp.wordcount) or more. 600 is the lowest scoring tier of Rank Math's lengthContent test (>=600 -> 2/8 points; the test fails below 600).
answers.site-howto-sizeslug: sizeSlug "large" (the plugin default is "full", and save() ignores it). It comes from the moksaweb.com canonical post 8594. This is a site-style rule, not a Rank Math rule.
answers.density-075-gap: 6/6, which is full points. The code checks fair as 0.5 to <0.75 and good as 0.76 to <1 with lodash inRange. Exactly 0.75 falls between those two ranges, so it lands in the best branch.
answers.powerword-prefix: At most 4 extra characters. The title word must equal a power word, or start with one and be no more than 4 characters longer.
answers.powerword-locale-count: 11 language files (de, en, es, fi, fr, hu, id, it, ja, nl, sv). Chinese is not among them.
answers.howto-empty-title: Nothing. The title element (h3.rank-math-howto-title) is left out when the title is empty, so the step div holds only the rank-math-howto-content div.
answers.faq-skip-rules: save() writes a question only if its title is not empty, its content is not empty, and visible is not false. A question with an empty title, empty content, or visible:false is left out.
answers.video-self-hosted: No. A video counts only if its iframe, video tag, [video] shortcode or bare URL points to YouTube or Vimeo. A self-hosted .mp4 does not count.
answers.in10-kb-vs-code: The KB says 300 words; the plugin code says 400. At or below that word count, the whole text is checked instead of only the first 10%.
answers.sample-density: FK density 1.96% (14 visible occurrences) over 714 visible words. That is in the full-score band (6/6), and content length scores 2/8.
answers.post-title-english-trust: 推論 (inferred). It is a moksaweb.com habit, but the reason (CJK font or breakage) has never been measured. It is also listed as an open question in data/pending.csv.
